title: Timing that cannot lie
prompt:
1. `static long timedSum(int n)` — time a loop summing 1..n with nanoTime; return
the elapsed NANOS. Verify the sum equals (long) n * (n + 1) / 2 and throw
IllegalStateException if it does not (defeat dead-code elimination by consuming
the result).
2. `static long warmMedianSum(int n, int rounds)` — for each of `rounds` rounds:
time the same sum, convert to microseconds, collect; return the MEDIAN of the
rounds (sort, take the middle). Warmup is inside: run the sum 2_000 times
untimed before measuring.
3. `static boolean nanoIsMonotonic()` — read nanoTime 1_000 times; return true iff
no read was less than its predecessor (strictly: never a NEGATIVE step).

tests.name: timed, consumed, honest
tests.hint: Consumed results survive DCE; monotonic holds.

tests.name: median after warmup
tests.code:
long us = Solution.warmMedianSum(1_000_000, 5);
checkTrue(us > 0, "median micros is positive: " + us);
